searchText: Are validators and stakers are different things in Eth 2.0 ? validator = protocol unit, for a signing key backed by 32 ETH of stake staker = entity running 1 or more validators. Similar to a miner that runs one or more GPUs Oh I see So Unless you have 32 eth staked you cannot be a validator but you can be a staker right ? There's a lot of nuance to that with SSV (multiple entitites running a share of a validator key, to come on consensus on the actions of a shared validator, before publishing them) Fyi, this is more of a question for the /r/ethstaker crowd on reddit, you can find them on discord too. This channel is focused purely on consensus.

excerpts.author: obi0837
excerpts.content: Are validators and stakers are different things in Eth 2.0 ?

excerpts.author: protolambda
excerpts.content:
validator = protocol unit, for a signing key backed by 32 ETH of stake
staker = entity running 1 or more validators. Similar to a miner that runs one or more GPUs
